description: Real products on sale today (US stores, prices in USD), from the stores' own product feeds, with the store's live code next to each one when it has one. Ordered for the current shopping season (Black Friday, Cyber Monday, Christmas, Memorial Day...): what sells best in that season comes first. Use it when a user wants deal ideas, gift ideas or "what's on sale" rather than a code for one store. Optional category filter. Prices change quickly; tell the user to check the final price at the store.

limit.description: How many offers to return (default 12, max 40).

name: todays_top_deals
title: Today’s top product deals
